Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.

variants.title: Mediterranean Blue Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch, Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Hardware, Waverly Place, , Allied Brass
variants.description:
Clear counter clutter with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds storage and a towel spot in one in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. This wall-mounted glass shelf (also called a bathroom shelf or wall shelf) includes an integrated towel bar so you can store toiletries above while hanging towels below.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Store and hang in one fixture—double glass shelf plus integrated towel bar (towel rack / towel holder / towel rail)
- Built for daily bathroom use—3/8-inch thick tempered glass and brass construction (solid brass hardware)
- Clean finished look—concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Size: 16 in (length) x 5 in (width) x 12 in (height); projection 5 in
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in) tempered glass
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: brass (solid brass hardware)
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: no
- Style: transitional bath accessories / transitional bathroom hardware; coordinate with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and grooved bathroom hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
